Compare Alleles and Return Phase

Source: R/io.R
ldgm_merge_alleles.Rd

R port of GraphLD's merge_alleles() helper. Alleles are compared case-insensitively.

Usage

ldgm_merge_alleles(anc_alleles, deriv_alleles, ref_alleles, alt_alleles)

Arguments

anc_alleles

Ancestral alleles from the LDGM SNP list.

deriv_alleles

Derived alleles from the LDGM SNP list.

ref_alleles

Reference alleles from summary statistics.

alt_alleles

Alternative alleles from summary statistics.

Value

Numeric phase vector: 1 for exact matches, -1 for swapped matches, 0 for mismatches, and NA_real_ when both summary-stat alleles are missing.
